title: Setting up a chair and microphone for Iola

blocks.x: Where are you going to sit? How you ever found this.
Actually, I knew that there was a file someplace that we’d thrown all this kind of stuff in, and George found it.
Can you bring Iola a chair, Russell? You’d rather have a straight chair, wouldn’t you?
There you go. Will she be able to be heard?
Should we get a microphone for her? Will the microphone pick her up? Kimery: It should be able to pick her up.
